title: Visual Acuity Improvement Prediction in Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration
description: We proposed a predictive pipeline that automates the extraction of clinical OCT biomarkers using fine-tuned DL models. The combination of these automated biomarkers with baseline best-corrected visual acuity serves as inputs for an interpretable classifier.

paper.title: Visual Acuity Improvement Prediction in Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration
paper.authors: Hadi Moazen, Mélanie Hébert, Alaa Eddine Ayadi, Ali Dirani, Audrey Durand

example_outputs.summary: For a simulated patient with BCVA 50 and SRF present, the model gives a 51% chance of gaining 10 or more letters. A misread SRF flag lowers it to 33%. The 1,203 eyes are simulated from the paper's reported marginals. Not for clinical use.
